column7: The access log kept every query value except on a few denylisted routes, so a secret placed in a query on any other route reached the log; and an allowlisted parameter name let any value through. Now only allowlisted names are logged, and only with a value matching that key's own grammar (digits, true/false/1/0, date/time, or a short lowercase enum with no kx_ prefix); everything else is [redacted]. A short all-lowercase secret under an enum key is not covered
